rationale: The failure is `connect ECONNREFUSED 127.0.0.1:3999` on both the initial attempt and retry, with 0.0s duration, meaning the test never reached the app. The diff shows `playwright.config.ts` was changed to hardcode `baseURL: "http://127.0.0.1:3999"` instead of the configured `PORT`, so the test is pointing at a port where no server is listening. This is a test-environment/configuration misconfiguration, not a product regression or flaky timing issue.
recommendedAction: Revert the `playwright.config.ts` change so `baseURL` uses the configured `PORT` (or start the app on port 3999), then re-run the test to confirm it passes.
